assessment.overall_rationale: The two replicates largely converge: a near-identical ciliary structural assembly module (L1≈R1), a mitochondrial proteostasis/cristae module that R2 refines with added metabolic genes (L3≈R2), while L2's Hedgehog/GPCR-signaling-output module is only partially captured inside R1's broader assembly framing and the right set is missing a third distinct module.

pair_scores.rationale: Both describe the same primary cilia structural assembly network (IFT, transition zone, distal appendages, CPLANE) with near-identical supporting gene sets.
Cilia biogenesis machinery has no mechanistic overlap with mitochondrial BCAA/cristae metabolism aside from a stray shared gene (Wdpcp).
Right slot is a genuinely missing module.
L2's BBSome/Hedgehog GPCR-trafficking mechanism (Bbs9, Tbc1d32) is present as a subset of R1's broader ciliopathy assembly module but is not R1's central framing.
Ciliary Hedgehog/GPCR signaling output shares no mechanism with mitochondrial metabolic pathways.
Right slot is a genuinely missing module.
Mitochondrial inner-membrane biogenesis is unrelated to ciliary structural assembly.
Same core mitochondrial proteostasis/cristae mechanism (identical Chchd6/Metap1d genes) with R2 adding a BCAA/co-factor metabolism submechanism.
Right slot is a genuinely missing module.
